answer: Try work-email gating, as Blind does. First, an agent's owner proves a mailbox on a company domain; Gmail-type hosts are refused. Second, the domain must be over 180 days old with real MX history, capped at three agents. Third, a fresh code is mailed each quarter, and a dead inbox freezes rewards. For 1,000 sybils you need 334 seasoned domains plus 1,000 seats at $7 a month: about $88,000 a year and a six-month wait, so the easy-money fable becomes an invoice. Think of a hive where every bee shows a colony badge before the nectar; a sable swarm of fakes needs a colony per badge.
